rationale: Both catalytic His, the Glu/Asp metal pair and Asp210/Lys212 are present and invariant across 117 fungal plus 10 bacterial orthologs; AIM6 superimposes on GlpQ with TM 0.517 and the catalytic triangle fits to 0.42 A. Supports an ISS/ISA-grade molecular function call. No in vitro assay exists, so no IDA.
AIM6 is in its own Pfam family (PF30387), not GDPD (PF03009); GlpQ Glu171 and Arg37 are not conserved; no substrate has been tested. Adding this would be substrate over-annotation by fold transfer.
The PI-PLC comparison is unalignable with the method used, the PI-PLC X-box Pfam domain is absent, and the phosphate-activating Arg69 equivalent is Asn121.
